$comment: Config for the docs-review Stop check. Declare what to watch in one of two ways. (1) patterns: a coarse list of path prefixes/globs; matched source files under src/ mirror to docs/ (single-root default). (2) mappings: an opt-in list of {sourceRoot, docRoot} pairs for repos with several source roots (e.g. a frontend/ + backend/ monorepo). Each source file under a sourceRoot mirrors into docRoot with its extension swapped for .md, e.g. frontend/src/components/Foo.vue -> docs/frontend/components/Foo.md. When mappings is present it takes precedence over patterns; see examples/portal/ for a worked config. The check fires only when a watched source file changes without its doc counterpart AND that doc already exists on disk (opt-in mirror policy); seed a new mirror with the `generate-docs` skill. stopBehavior: interactive nags the LLM in-session; background (default) spawns a detached headless Claude to reconcile.
